nodes.name: benchmark.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the SWE-bench-Pro / terminal-bench agent benchmarking subsystem: task indexing, preflight checks, run-plan construction, agent-batch orchestration (spawn/cancel/evaluate sessions), Python evaluator environment bootstrapping, and process/log lifecycle management for benchmark runs.
